title: Animated changelog and a version log component

entries.text: Version log: an animated version history component. The rail draws and dots pop as releases scroll in, entries slide in one by one, releases fold open, with a version jump strip and a kind filter. The changelog page uses it.
A changelog page on the docs site. Click any component name to open it.
95 new icons (189 in total): devices and media, commerce, charts, text formatting, files, map and travel, status, playback and more. Find them on the Icons page.

title: Sixty new components, blocks and a smarter CLI

entries.text: Page furniture and content: changelog, testimonial card, comment thread, code block, status dot, table of contents.
Search and input helpers: search bar with live results, currency input, inline edit, filter bar, notification center, cookie consent.
Roles and access grid: permission matrix with per-column toggles and locked roles.
Tooltip gets a title, keyboard shortcut, light style and arrow, plus InfoTip and TruncatedText.
Data table gets row selection with bulk actions, a column menu, sticky header, toolbar slot, row action menus and clickable rows. Table gets a footer and caption.
Boards, feeds and menus: kanban, activity feed, context menu.
Loader with six animations, a bar and an overlay.
Date range picker gets quick presets (Last 7 days, This month and more) and a day count.
Reports table block: search, filters, sorting, row actions and a details drawer.
Online shop pieces: product card, coupon input, order summary.
Layout and lists: split pane, sortable list, navbar, bottom navigation, floating action button.
People and conversation: chat, mention input, profile card, terminal, error state, image viewer.
Charts and files: line chart, radar chart, audit log, file manager.
Mobile and uploads: swipe actions, pull to refresh, bottom sheet, date and time picker, image upload.
Avatar gets presence dots, square shape, an extra-large size, hover names on groups and UserInfo.
Avatar upload with instant preview.
Forms and settings: schema form (multi-step wizard), rich text editor, notification preferences, saved views.
Planning and flow: funnel chart, gantt chart, org chart, approval flow, onboarding checklist, tag manager.
Shortcuts dialog (press ?) and number formatting helpers.
Sales dashboard block: KPI cards, revenue line chart, funnel and top deals.
befui update command adds missing animations to your index.css; befui add warns when one is missing. befui mcp runs an MCP server for AI tools.
Every component now uses the built-in icon set. lucide-react is no longer installed by init.
The docs site loads demos on demand (main bundle 1.4 MB down to 0.58 MB), and llms.txt is grouped by category with rules and a task map.
Time category: time picker, analog clock, world clock, stopwatch, timer, countdown and relative time.
Heatmap and pricing card.
llms.txt and llms-full.txt, AGENTS.md rules written by init, a Use with AI page, and befui add all.

Inputs and forms: button, input, label and field, checkbox, switch, select, combobox, calendar, date picker, segmented, slider, radio group, rating, OTP input, tag input, number stepper, chip, color picker.
Display and motion: accordion, spotlight card, border beam, marquee, carousel, compare, tilt card, shimmer text, typewriter, confetti, dock, collapsible, tree view.
Data and layout: data table, gauge, progress ring, number ticker, stat card, charts, sidebar, app shell.
Feedback and overlays: banner, alert, toast, skeleton, dialog and sheet, alert dialog, dropdown menu, popover, tooltip, command palette.
A built-in icon set, Storybook, the befui CLI (init, add, list), and HRMS and marketing blocks.
